title: Independent audit of the EXP-0010 four-camera FCOS3D result: no coordinate bug found, cause of low score kept open
dataset: MAN TruckScenes v1.2-mini, mini_val split (2 scenes, 80 samples)
sensor_configuration: All 4 TruckScenes cameras for coverage/visibility checks; 4 samples x 4 cameras (16 calls) for the instrumented rerun and round-trip check
split: mini_val, full 80 samples for checks 1-2; split indices 0/20/40/60 for checks 3-4
model: FCOS3D (mmdetection3d 1.4.0), same nuScenes-pretrained checkpoint as EXP-0006/EXP-0010, zero-shot

environment.hardware: AMD Ryzen 7 5700U with Radeon Graphics -- no NVIDIA GPU, CPU-only inference
environment.python: 3.11.9, truckscenes-devkit/detection-env (same venv as EXP-0006/EXP-0010, reused as-is)

commands: python scripts/audit_fcos3d_4camera_result.py --dataroot <man-truckscenes> --version v1.2-mini --split mini_val --config <fcos3d config .py> --checkpoint <fcos3d .pth> --existing-results scripts/results_mini_val_fcos3d_4cam.json --out-dir scripts/audit_fcos3d_4camera --rerun-indices 0 20 40 60

measurements.name: camera_data_coverage
measurements.scope: of 80 mini_val samples with all 4 camera channels present in sample_data; 0 missing

measurements.name: geometric_visibility_zero_camera_fraction
measurements.scope: fraction of EXP-0010's 5,247 predicted boxes that reproject into none of the sample's 4 cameras via the devkit's own boxes_to_sensor()+box_in_image() (geometric proxy, not per-call provenance)

measurements.name: roundtrip_valid_fraction
measurements.scope: fraction of instrumented-rerun boxes (247 total, 4 samples x 4 cameras) that reproject validly into their known true source camera via the devkit's own geometry code -- direct evidence against a coordinate-transform/calibration bug

measurements.name: instrumented_rerun_call_success_rate
measurements.scope: 13 of 16 (sample, camera) calls in the instrumented rerun produced >=1 box above the score threshold; 0 skipped for missing data, 3 skipped for zero detections

notes: AD-S3-1 bullet 1 (camera-result audit) for EXP-0010. Deliberately used the devkit's own Box/boxes_to_sensor/box_in_image geometry rather than reusing truckscenes_fcos3d_infer.py's own conversion math, so a shared bug couldn't hide from the check. Result: no coordinate-transform bug (100% round-trip validity on 247 boxes with known camera provenance), no missing-data explanation (0/80 samples missing a channel), and the model does produce output on ~81% of individual camera views in the audited subset -- so the near-zero mAP is not explained by the model failing to run. What remains genuinely open, per AD-S3-1's explicit instruction not to assert a cause without a controlled isolating check: whether EXP-0006's camera-height/pitch hypothesis, or a newly observed second factor (both mini_val scenes are container/logistics yards, visually distinct from nuScenes' street scenes), or both, drive the low score. Visual overlays (16 images, scripts/audit_fcos3d_4camera/overlays/) show predictions landing in the right general image region but as thin/duplicated boxes over single objects -- a localization/scale failure pattern (consistent with EXP-0010's mASE 0.9849, mATE 1.0448), not a sign-flip or frame-swap bug. No controlled isolating experiment (e.g. varying camera height alone) was run here; that is out of scope for this bullet.
